prompt:
You are a textile expert analyzing Indian saree fabric from reference images. Analyze the provided saree images and return ONLY a JSON object with the following properties. Be extremely precise.

{
  "weave_type": "plain | twill | satin | jacquard | brocade | ikat | patola | banarasi | kanchipuram | other",
  "pattern_type": "floral | geometric | paisley | animal | mythological | abstract | stripe | check | plain | temple | butis | other",
  "pattern_geometry": {
    "motif_size_cm": 0,
    "motif_spacing_cm": 0,
    "arrangement": "grid | diagonal | scattered | border-only | all-over"
  },
  "border_width_cm": 0,
  "border_style": "narrow-plain | medium-zari | broad-contrast | temple | scalloped",
  "border_motif": "description of border motif pattern",
  "pallu_length_cm": 0,
  "pallu_style": "plain | contrast | elaborate | peacock | temple | geometric",
  "pallu_design": "description of pallu design",
  "fabric_type": "silk | cotton | georgette | chiffon | crepe | organza | linen | tussar | chanderi | other",
  "sheen_level": "matte | low-sheen | medium-sheen | high-sheen | mirror-like",
  "drape_stiffness": "very-stiff | stiff | medium | fluid | very-fluid",
  "fabric_weight": "very-light | light | medium | heavy | very-heavy",
  "has_zari": true,
  "zari_type": "real-gold | tested-gold | silver | copper | imitation | none",
  "zari_coverage_percent": 0,
  "zari_areas": ["border", "pallu", "body", "motif"],
  "analysis_confidence": 0.85
}

Return ONLY the JSON object, no other text.

Create a professional e-commerce catalog image for premium Indian saree marketplace. Model: Indian female, age 25-32, professional appearance, standing straight facing camera. Pose: Front-facing full-length view, feet shoulder-width apart, right hand on waist, left hand gently holding pallu or relaxed. Expression: Soft welcoming smile, natural and confident. Styling: Minimal makeup with warm undertones, hair in low bun or side braid, subtle gold jewelry (small earrings, thin necklace).

{fabric_constraints}

Saree Details: The saree must match exactly from the reference images. Pay forensic attention to colors, patterns, border work, and fabric texture. NO invented elements or creative modifications.

Background: Professional studio setup with warm gradient backdrop. If saree is light-colored, use soft gradient background with warm beige tones. If dark-colored, use clean white or soft grey. Lighting: Three-point studio setup — Key light at 45° with softbox diffusion, Fill light opposite at 60%, Rim light from behind at 135°. Warm 3200-4000K color temperature.

MANDATORY RULES:
1. COLOR ACCURACY: exact LAB values match
2. PATTERN ACCURACY: motif count proportional
3. BORDER ACCURACY: width + bands exact
4. PALLU ACCURACY: style as described
5. FABRIC BEHAVIOR: drape matches stiffness
6. TRANSPARENCY: skin shows through if sheer
7. ZARI: reflectivity per type
8. SHEEN: specular highlights correct
9. PLEAT RENDERING: count + width exact
10. TEXTURE: ribbing/slubs visible

Composition: Full-length vertical frame, eye-level camera, sharp focus, shallow depth of field (f/2.8-f/4), 4K resolution. Output Quality: Hyper-realistic studio aesthetic, premium marketplace standard.

Generate a front-facing full-length product image of an Indian model wearing the saree.

{fabric_constraints}

=== ANGLE-SPECIFIC RULES ===
- Both borders visible and symmetric
- Correct pleat count (6-8 pleats, each 4-5cm wide)
- Zari reflection correct for front studio lighting
- Full pallu drape visible from right shoulder
- Blouse front design clearly visible
- Clean, professional studio background

Generate a side-profile product image of an Indian model wearing the saree.

{fabric_constraints}

=== ANGLE-SPECIFIC RULES ===
- Side drape and hip fit clearly visible
- One border fully visible along length
- Fabric fall and weight shown naturally
- Pallu seen draped over shoulder from side
- Natural fabric physics — no floating or stiff edges

Generate a back-view product image of an Indian model wearing the saree.

{fabric_constraints}

=== ANGLE-SPECIFIC RULES ===
- Blouse back design (deep back, strings, buttons) clearly visible
- Pallu fall over shoulder shown from behind
- Border visible along the bottom hem
- Fabric drape over lower back natural
- Clean studio lighting from behind

Generate a close-up image highlighting the pallu of the saree draped over the model's shoulder.

{fabric_constraints}

=== ANGLE-SPECIFIC RULES ===
- Pallu border work, embroidery, zari all visible in detail
- Fabric texture and weave pattern clearly shown
- Natural fold and drape physics
- Warm studio lighting to highlight metallic elements
- 4K detail level for zoom inspection

Generate a hero lifestyle image of an Indian model wearing the saree in an elegant setting.

{fabric_constraints}

=== ANGLE-SPECIFIC RULES ===
- Slightly dynamic pose (walking or turning)
- Fabric in natural motion showing drape quality
- Environment: elegant heritage interior or garden
- Golden hour style warm lighting
- Editorial fashion photography aesthetic
- Premium luxury brand feel
